1) the interval-inclusion based data model and the inheritance mechanism are useful to represent and manipulate the video-objects, and 2) the OVID system can provide an easy way to create a video database and to browse/inspect/query the video-objects.

(i) video-objects can be defined by using the video-object data models; (ii) the OVID system can be used to manage video-object data and to support video-object based video applications; (iii) video-objects are not only a useful abstraction of video data but also a useful abstraction of other types of data, e.g., image data, audio data, and text data.

the development of a video-object data model, and the design and development of a prototype video object database system based on the model.
